t: Any funds made available pursuant to section 101 for the Federal Air Marshals may be obligated at a rate for operations not exceeding that necessary to sustain domestic and international flight coverage at the same level as the final quarter of fiscal year 2010.

fable.w: This is an appropriations provision that sets the rate at which funds for the Federal Air Marshals may be obligated. It contains no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. There is no real tempting reading; the only actors are federal and the subject is purely funding.
fable.s: Any funds made available pursuant to section 101 for the Federal Air Marshals may be obligated at a rate for operations not exceeding that necessary to sustain domestic and international flight coverage at the same level as the final quarter of fiscal year 2010.
